notes:
AI-retrieval agent group (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot,
Claude-User, YouBot, DuckAssistBot) uses "Allow: /$" to explicitly permit exactly the root
URL, before falling to "Disallow: /" for everything else not covered by the allow-list.
Reading "$" as a proper end-anchor (RFC 9309), root is allowed for these agents -> ABSENT.
Note: the audit tool's own robots_parser.py does prefix-matching only and does not
recognize "$" as an anchor, so it would evaluate this same robots.txt as blocking root
(PRESENT) - flagging this in case the gold label is meant to track the tool's actual
parser behavior rather than spec-correct intent.

notes: robots.txt (HTTP 200, fetched successfully) has an explicit training-class group blocking every major training-class crawler at root: User-agent: GPTBot / Google-Extended / ClaudeBot / Amazonbot / CCBot / Bytespider / Meta-ExternalAgent / Applebot-Extended / cohere-ai / Diffbot followed by Disallow: /.
